access_codes_uses_check.name: access_codes_uses_check
access_codes_uses_check.value: max_uses > 0 AND uses_count >= 0 AND uses_count <= max_uses

subscriptions_split_check.name: subscriptions_split_check
subscriptions_split_check.value: (plan IS NULL AND university_id IS NULL AND share_bps IS NULL AND university_amount IS NULL AND platform_amount IS NULL) OR (plan IS NOT NULL AND university_id IS NOT NULL AND share_bps IS NOT NULL AND university_amount IS NOT NULL AND platform_amount IS NOT NULL AND share_bps >= 0 AND share_bps <= 10000 AND university_amount >= 0 AND platform_amount >= 0 AND university_amount + platform_amount = amount)

users_role_university_scope_check.name: users_role_university_scope_check
users_role_university_scope_check.value: ("users"."role" = 'super_admin' AND "users"."university_id" IS NULL) OR ("users"."role" <> 'super_admin' AND "users"."university_id" IS NOT NULL)
